subject: Mobile Development
title: Netflix vs. Apple's Rules
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Netflix vs. Apple's Rules.

hook.text: Netflix stopped allowing in-app subscriptions on iOS in 2018. Apple lost millions.

buildup.text: Netflix refused to give Apple 30% of subscription revenue. They sent users to the web.

discovery.text: Spotify, Amazon, and others followed — removing purchase buttons from their iOS apps.

twist.text: Apple's rules banned apps from even telling users they could pay on the web.

climax.text: The biggest apps found ways around the tax, but small developers have no such leverage.

punchline.text: Big enough to refuse the tax; too small to fight it.

quiz.question: Why did Netflix stop in-app subscriptions on iOS?
options: Netflix was banned from the App Store
